title: Relic Guardian
next_chapter_hook: Just as the guardian's remnant soul was about to dissipate completely, he exhausted his final shred of strength to whisper: 'Your father came here once, seeking the same answer...' The words struck like thunder, exploding within Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

text.content:
A cold voice coiled around his Mental Sea like a venomous serpent, Chen Ji's pupils contracting sharply. He下意识 gripped the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve, his knuckles whitening. Three years of meticulous planning, numerous hidden pieces—would it all collapse at this moment?

"Found you, child of destiny." The voice spoke again, carrying the playful mockery of a cat toying with prey. "The Demonic Path commander-in-chief's lock won't last forever—you have roughly three hours."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm. Three hours was enough time to do many things. He surveyed his surroundings and discovered he stood at the entrance of a concealed valley—this was the location of the Ancient Forbidden Land. He had come precisely for this, never expecting the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's perception to be so razor-sharp.

"Looks like I'll have to speed things up." He murmured to himself, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes.

dialogue.content:
The instant he stepped into the valley, the Spiritual Energy concentration in the air surged dramatically, thickening almost into tangible substance. Chen Ji's footsteps faltered, his vision suddenly opening up—a towering stone gate stood deep within the valley, its lintel carved with cryptic ancient runes that emitted a faint cyan glow.

"Tianqing Sect's whelp, you've finally arrived." An aged yet commanding voice emanated from behind the stone gate, resonant as an ancient bell. "This old one has been waiting for quite some time."

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, though his mind raced with calculations. This voice arrived too abruptly—this was no benevolent presence. He slowly drew the sword from his back, its blade shimmering with cold light as Spiritual Energy surged around it.

The stone gate creaked open, and a phantom figure emerged. It was an elderly specter clad in shattered battle armor, his features indistinct yet exuding an unmistakable air ofdignified. His gaze seemed to penetrate Chen Ji's physical form, examining the blood flowing within him.

"Holder of the Tianji Record," the guardian's phantom slowly spoke, "but your bloodline remains incompletely awakened. What qualifies you to enter this place?"

choice.prompt: The Relic Guardian manifests and questions him—Chen Ji must prove his qualification as the Tianji Record inheritor. How will he face this ancient existence?

choices.description: Directly reveal the Tianji Record Fragment, demanding entry as an inheritor with one's identity. Simple and direct, but risks exposing one's trump card.
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record's aura may be leaked
choices.risk_hint: May attract more factions coveting the Tianji Record

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression remained composed as he retrieved the Tianji Record Fragment from his sleeve. The yellowed pages gleamed with ancient radiance under the sunlight, the runes upon them seeming to come alive, slowly flowing and circulating. The guardian's phantom's eyes suddenly blazed, his form trembling slightly.

"This aura... indeed, it is authentic." The guardian's voice carried a tremor of emotion. "But a fragment alone is insufficient. You must prove yourself worthy of inheriting the complete version."

choices.description: Don't rush to reveal one's trump card—first probe the guardian's purpose and weaknesses. Maneuver verbally to find openings.
choices.visible_reward: Gather more information while keeping the trump card mysterious
choices.risk_hint: The guardian may think one is being evasive and increase the trial's difficulty

text.content:
Chen Ji returned the fragment to his sleeve, a faint smile crossing his lips. That smile was warm and harmless, yet it caused the guardian's phantom to furrow his brow slightly.

"The elder speaks of incomplete bloodline awakening," Chen Ji clasped his hands in greeting, "this junior ventures to ask—what constitutes complete awakening? And how does one prove it?"

The guardian studied him for a moment, thedignified tone of his voice carrying a hint of amusement: "You certainly have composure. Far better than those impatient fools." The phantom stood with hands clasped behind his back. "Very well, since you've come, let us begin the trial."

The guardian's phantom raised his hand and waved it. The rocky wall beside the stone gate trembled violently, revealing a massive circular altar. At its center hovered an ancient sword, its blade wrapped in dense chains, each link carved with intricate runes.

"This is the 'Heavenly Fate Trial,'" the guardian's voice reverberated through the valley, "You must use the Tianji Record's power to sever three chains. Each chain severed will bring corresponding backlash."

He paused, a strange smile flickering in his eyes: "Of course, should you withdraw midway, the chains will devour your Heavenly Fate completely."

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. Heavenly Fate—he currently had less than thirty points remaining. This trial was unmistakably a high-stakes gamble.

Just then, a clear and familiar voice rang out in his heart: "Brother, be careful."

Chen Ji's body trembled slightly. This was Chen Nian's voice—his sister, that relative who was taken by the Holy Sect and became the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' He had not sensed her presence in a very long time.

"Niannian?" He called out in his heart.

"I sense danger," Chen Nian's voice carried weakness and worry, "That person... he's not an ordinary guardian. He's searching for something."

Chen Ji's eyes flashed with insight. As a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Chen Nian possessed special sensitivity to matters related to the Tianji Record. Her warning was certainly not without purpose.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, steadying his emotions. Regardless of the guardian's intentions, he must pass this trial now, or in three hours the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's lock would bring catastrophic destruction.

"This junior accepts the trial." He strode toward the altar, drawing his sword.

The guardian's phantom gave a slight nod, a subtle satisfaction flickering in his eyes. However, the instant Chen Ji stepped onto the altar, a majestic Spiritual Pressure descended like a mountain, nearly buckling his knees.

"The first chain seals your perception." The guardian's voice was cold and commanding. "Sever it, and you shall see through all illusions—including your own destiny."

choice.prompt: The trial of the first chain begins—the guardian requires Chen Ji to sever the chain sealing perception. How should he activate the Tianji Record's power?

choices.description: Regardless of cost, push the Tianji Record's power to the extreme, severing the chain with absolute force. Consumes 10 points of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully severed the chains, perception greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is already scarce, such consumption will make it unsustainable later

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly burned hot. He held nothing back, Spiritual Energy surging from his body like a tide into that yellowed paper. In an instant, a brilliant cyan light burst from his palm, rushing straight toward that chain!

"Break!"

The cyan light collided with the chain, producing a sound like clashing metal. The Guardian's phantom slightly narrowed his eyes, seemingly not expecting such decisiveness. The chain trembled violently under the cyan light's erosion, the runes upon it shattering one by one—

"Snap!"

The first chain, broken! Chen Ji felt as if some shackle in his mind had shattered, his perception instantly multiplying several times over. He could even "see" the weak soul fluctuations within the Guardian's phantom.

choices.text: Break the chains with skillful technique
choices.description: Not clashing head-on, observe the weaknesses in the chain's runes, strike precisely with minimal cost. Consumes 5 Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully severed the chains, retaining more Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: Requires more precise control, slight carelessness may lead to failure

text.content:
Chen Ji did not rush to act. He stared at that chain, his perception fully opened. The power of the Tianji Record circulated within him, allowing him to faintly "see" the pattern of the runes' operation.

"So that's how it is..." A slight smile curved his lips, "The chain's power is concentrated at three nodes."

He raised his sword, the blade's light like silk, precisely piercing the chain's weak points. No earth-shaking collision, only three faint crisp sounds—the rune nodes shattered one by one, and the chain fell.

The Guardian's phantom flickered with a hint of surprise: "You could actually see through this chain's structure?"

"The junior was just lucky." Chen Ji said calmly, but in his heart hesneered— with his perception enhanced, what was this petty trick?

The moment the first chain broke, a series of fragmented images flashed through Chen Ji's mind—

A man with similar features to his own, kneeling before this altar, tears streaming down his face. In the man's hand was a scroll of yellowed paper—the Tianji Record!

"I'll be back..." The man's voice was hoarse and desperate, "Nian Nian, wait for me..."

The image vanished in a flash, and Chen Ji snapped back to reality, cold sweat already soaking his back. This... was this his father's memory?

The Guardian's phantom seemed to sense something, giving him a meaningful glance: "What did you sense?"

Chen Ji's expression remained normal, but his voice carried a chill: "Nothing. Continue."

dialogue.content:
The Guardian's phantom was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "The second chain seals your power. Sever it, and the Spiritual Energy within you will be completely liberated."

Chen Ji looked at the sword at the center of the altar—or rather, the many chains binding that sword. The second chain was even more robust than the first, its runes flowing ceaselessly, emitting a terrifying pressure.

"Interesting." He murmured. This chain was clearly more than twice as strong as the first.

He took a deep breath and activated the Tianji Record once more. This time, he did not rush to act, instead spreading his perception to try to capture the chain's weakness. However, this time his perception seemed to hit an invisible wall—nothing could be probed.

choice.prompt: The second chain's defense far exceeds the first, Chen Ji's perception cannot penetrate it. How should he deal with this more powerful trial?

choices.description: Since perception is useless, crush it with absolute power. Go all out with one strike, forcibly sever the chain. Consumes 15 Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully severed the chain, Spiritual Energy completely liberated
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will be nearly depleted, creating problems for subsequent trials and escaping the Demonic Path Commander's lock

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes turned fierce, his hands forming seals, the Tianji Record Fragment blazing with dazzling light in his palm. He poured all his Spiritual Energy into it, an unprecedented power surging from within—

"Sever!"

The sword light like a rainbow, carrying enough force to tear mountains, heavily hacked onto the second chain! In the rumbling sound, the Guardian's phantom's robes were blown about by the blast. The chain trembled violently, runes exploding one by one—

"Boom!"

The second chain, broken! Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping heavily. The Spiritual Energy within him surged like a flood breaching a dam, and his cultivation actually broke through in this moment—from late Foundation Building directly jumping to Foundation Building Peak!

choices.description: Attempt to communicate with the Guardian's phantom, asking him to temporarily remove part of the defense so the junior can complete the trial with skillful technique.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, gain the Guardian's recognition
choices.risk_hint: The Guardian might use this to probe his true capabilities

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly. He put away his sword, clasped his hands toward the Guardian's phantom and said: "Senior, this chain's defense is extraordinary, the junior ventures to ask—is there a clever method?"

The Guardian's phantom was silent for a long while, then suddenly let out a low laugh: "You're quite candid." He stood with hands behind his back, "Very well, for your father's sake, I'll give you a hint—that sword is the key."

Chen Ji followed his gaze to the center of the altar. That ancient sword bound by chains had a subtle crack on its blade, faint and elusive. His eyes flashed—he understood! The sword spirit!

"Many thanks for the senior's guidance." Chen Ji bowed again, this time truly sincere.

Just as Chen Ji was pondering how to deal with the second chain, the ancient sword on the altar suddenly vibrated violently. A weak but determined consciousness entered his mind:

"Inheritor... I am the sword spirit of this blade... sealed for a thousand years..."

Chen Ji's heart stirred, his consciousness probing toward that ancient sword. He "saw" a vague humanoid phantom—the sword spirit was already weak to the extreme, on the verge of dissipation at any moment.

"The chain's power comes from my suffering," the sword spirit's voice was断续续, "If you can temporarily share my pain... the chains will loosen..."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed. Share the pain? This meant he would have to endure part of the seal's backlash.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate for long. He walked to the altar and pressed his hand against the blade of the ancient sword. In an instant, a piercing pain spread from his palm throughout his entire body, as if millions of needles were piercing into his flesh and blood simultaneously.

"Um..." he groaned, veins bulging on his forehead. But he did not let go. Instead, he channeled the power of the Tianji Record into the sword, merging it with the sword spirit's power.

A miracle occurred—the runes on the chains began to flash frantically, and the defensive force weakened rapidly. A trace of surprise flickered in the guardian phantom's eyes, then turned into relief.

"Good lad..." he murmured, "Your father made the same choice back then."

Chen Ji gritted his teeth and, seizing this moment, swung the sword—"Clatter"—the second chain shattered on cue!

text.content:
At the moment the second chain broke, Chen Ji felt the spiritual energy within him thoroughly boil. That force, suppressed for years, broke through its constraints like a flood, surging and raging through his meridians.

"This is..." He stared at his hands in disbelief. The spiritual energy in his palm had already condensed into substance, glowing with a faint cyan light.

The guardian phantom slowly spoke: "The third chain seals your memories. Once severed, you will inherit all the memories of past inheritors—including your father's."

Chen Ji's heart trembled violently. His father had been missing for many years, and his mother had only said he was searching for a way to "change his fate." Now, the answer lay before him.

However, the guardian's voice carried a hint of gravity: "But this also means you will bear all the pain and regret of every past inheritor. Are you certain you wish to inherit?"

At this moment, a familiar voice rang out once more in Chen Ji's heart: "Brother, no matter what you see... I'm standing with you."

It was Chen Nian. This sister, taken away by the Holy Sect and becoming a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, was crossing a thousand miles to send him warmth. Chen Ji took a deep breath, and an indescribable emotion surged in his heart.

"I'm certain." He looked up, his gaze firm as he stared at the guardian phantom, "I want to know the truth."

The guardian phantom was silent for a long while before finally slowly nodding: "Since that's the case... Go then, inherit your fate."

He waved his hand, and the third chain shattered abruptly. At the same moment, a torrent of memories poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—

Countless scenes flickered before Chen Ji's eyes like a kaleidoscope.

He saw a young man obtain the Tianji Record Fragment, full of ambition, believing he could reverse fate.

He saw that young man grow, strengthen, establish forces, yet be toyed with by fate step by step, losing his loved ones in pain.

He saw a middle-aged man kneeling before this very altar, tears streaming down his face, clutching a yellowed scroll tightly in his hands—it was his father!

"Nian Nian..." His father's voice was hoarse and desperate, "I can't find you... The Tianji Record says your fate lies with the Holy Sect... but I can't enter..."

The scene shifted, and his father lay in a pool of blood, still tightly gripping the Tianji Record. His eyes remained unclosed until death, full of reluctance and longing.

Chen Ji's entire body trembled, and tears had blurred his vision at some point.

The torrent of memories gradually calmed. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. His gaze had changed—gaining a share of vicissitudes and heaviness, yet also a share of determination.

"I saw it." His voice was hoarse yet unusually calm, "Father... never gave up on us."

The guardian phantom watched him, eyes flickering with complex emotions: "Your father was the closest to success among all inheritors. Unfortunately, he ultimately failed the final trial."

"What trial?" Chen Ji pressed.

The guardian phantom did not answer. He looked up at the sky, and the phantom began to fade: "Time is running out. The Demonic Path commander will lock onto this location in less than an hour. You must leave here quickly."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's heart tightened. Three hours of time, now only one hour remaining. He had to make a choice.

"Senior," he looked at the guardian phantom, "You said my father couldn't pass the final trial. What was that trial?"

The guardian phantom's form had already faded until nearly transparent. He looked at Chen Ji, and suddenly a smile appeared in his eyes—that was relief, hope, and... release.

"You're different from him," the guardian's voice grew lighter, "You possess something he didn't."

"What thing?" Chen Ji pressed.

The guardian did not answer. His gaze passed over Chen Ji, as if seeing something distant.

text.content:
Just as the guardian's form was about to completely dissipate, he suddenly spoke, voice as light as a sigh:

"Your father came here once, seeking the same answer."

This sentence struck like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He suddenly recalled the scene of his father kneeling before the altar in his memory—that man had spoken these same words!

"Senior!" Chen Ji reached out to hold on, but only grasped emptiness.

The guardian phantom completely vanished, leaving only an echo in the valley:

"Remember, the true secret of the Tianji Record... lies not in foreseeing the future... but in..."

The voice stopped abruptly. The guardian, had vanished.

The valley fell into dead silence. Chen Ji stood alone before the altar, his heart churning with complex emotions.

He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. After this trial, the runes on the fragment were brighter than before, as if infused with new power. He could sense that his connection with the Tianji Record had become even closer.

"Not in foreseeing the future... but in..."

What were the words the guardian couldn't finish? Chen Ji faintly felt he had touched the edge of some truth, yet was still one step away.

In the distance, a bizarre red light suddenly appeared in the sky. The Demonic Path commander's lock was approaching.

"It's time to go." Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record, his gaze turning sharp. No matter what lay ahead, he had to survive—to find Chen Nian, to investigate the truth of his father's death, and even more—to break that so-called fate.
